cohort: Singleton term breech deliveries in Norway from 1991 to 2011 (n = 30,861)
finding: While neonatal morbidity was significantly higher in planned vaginal deliveries compared to planned cesarean deliveries, the higher mortality observed in planned vaginal deliveries was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: Neonatal morbidity outcomes were significantly worse in planned vaginal deliveries compared with planned cesarean deliveries in both periods.
